name: Common Internal Audit Pack
description: Industry-neutral internal audit content: COSO-based control library for procure-to-pay, IT general controls, treasury & commodity risk and governance.
disclaimer: Clause summaries are paraphrased for retrieval and citation only; they are not the authoritative text. All entries are draft pending domain-expert review.

clauses.title: Structures, reporting lines, authorities
clauses.summary: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in pursuit of objectives.

clauses.title: Identifies and analyses risk
clauses.summary: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyses them as a basis for determining how they should be managed.

clauses.title: Selects and develops control activities
clauses.summary: The entity selects and develops control activities, including segregation of duties, that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.

clauses.title: General controls over technology
clauses.summary: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology, including access security and change management, to support objectives.

clauses.title: Deploys through policies and procedures
clauses.summary: Control activities are deployed through policies that establish expectations and procedures that put policies into action, performed timely by competent personnel.

clauses.title: Uses relevant, quality information
clauses.summary: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.

clauses.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
clauses.summary: The entity selects, develops and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether components of internal control are present and functioning.

clauses.title: Evaluates and communicates deficiencies
clauses.summary: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those responsible for corrective action, including senior management and the board.

clauses.title: Qualifying criteria for hedge accounting
clauses.summary: Hedge accounting is permitted only if the relationship has eligible items, is formally designated and documented at inception (risk management objective, strategy, hedged item, instrument, how effectiveness is assessed), and meets the hedge effectiveness requirements.

clauses.title: Directors' responsibility: internal financial controls
clauses.summary: For listed companies, the directors' responsibility statement confirms that internal financial controls were laid down and were adequate and operating effectively.

controls.title: Vendor master changes are approved and independently reviewed
controls.objective: Only authorised, validated changes are made to vendor master data, including bank details.
controls.risk: Fraudulent or erroneous payments through unauthorised changes to vendor bank details.
testOfDesign: Inspect the vendor master change SOP and confirm approval and call-back verification requirements.
Confirm the ERP restricts vendor master maintenance to the master-data team.
testOfEffectiveness: From the vendor master change log select a sample and inspect approval evidence and independent bank-detail call-back for each.
Confirm the change log is complete by reconciling to ERP table change history.
checklist: Is every vendor bank-detail change supported by an approved request?
Was an independent call-back performed before the change took effect?
controls.recommendation: Enforce approval and independent call-back for all vendor bank-detail changes, and review the ERP change log monthly.

controls.title: Three-way match before invoice payment
controls.objective: Invoices are paid only when matched to an approved purchase order and goods receipt within tolerance.
controls.risk: Payment for goods not ordered or not received.
testOfDesign: Inspect the ERP match configuration and tolerance settings.
Confirm who can override a match block.
testOfEffectiveness: Select a sample of paid invoices and agree each to PO and GRN within tolerance.
Inspect overrides of match blocks for approval.
checklist: Are match tolerances configured as per policy?
controls.recommendation: Restrict match-block overrides to authorised approvers and review overrides monthly.

controls.title: Periodic user access review of key systems
controls.objective: Access to ERP and quality systems is limited to users with a current business need.
controls.risk: Inappropriate or excessive access enabling unauthorised transactions or data changes.
testOfDesign: Inspect the access review procedure for scope (systems, privileged roles) and reviewer independence.
testOfEffectiveness: For sampled quarters inspect evidence that business owners reviewed complete user lists and that removals were actioned timely.
checklist: Were all in-scope systems reviewed each quarter?
Were leavers removed within the policy timeline?
controls.recommendation: Complete quarterly access reviews for all in-scope systems and track removals to closure.

controls.title: Segregation of duties enforced in ERP
controls.objective: Incompatible duties (e.g. create vendor and post payment) are not held by one user without mitigation.
controls.risk: Fraud or error going undetected because one person controls a transaction end to end.
testOfDesign: Inspect the SoD rule set and confirm it covers key incompatible duties.
testOfEffectiveness: Run or inspect the SoD conflict report for sampled quarters and verify conflicts are removed or have documented mitigating controls.
checklist: Are SoD conflicts identified and either removed or mitigated?
controls.recommendation: Remediate SoD conflicts or document and operate mitigating controls; review quarterly.

controls.title: Board-approved hedging and treasury risk policy with limits
controls.objective: Commodity, FX and interest-rate exposures are hedged within a board-approved policy and limit framework.
controls.risk: Speculative or unauthorised positions leading to material losses.
testOfDesign: Inspect the hedging policy for approval, review date, authorised instruments, tenor and volume limits, and delegations of authority.
testOfEffectiveness: Confirm the current policy was approved by the board or its committee and that limits in trading systems agree to the policy.
checklist: Is the policy approved and reviewed within the last 12 months?
Do system limits match policy limits?
controls.recommendation: Re-approve the hedging policy annually and reconcile system limits to the approved policy.

controls.title: Independent daily monitoring of positions against limits
controls.objective: Open commodity and FX positions are monitored daily against limits by a function independent of trading.
controls.risk: Limit breaches not detected or escalated, increasing exposure to price movements.
testOfDesign: Confirm the middle office is independent of the front office and that breach escalation is defined.
testOfEffectiveness: For sampled days inspect the daily position report, evidence of review and escalation of any breach.
checklist: Was the daily position report reviewed by middle office?
Were breaches escalated and approved per policy?
controls.recommendation: Ensure independent daily limit monitoring with documented escalation and approval of every breach.

controls.title: Trade confirmations independently matched
controls.objective: Every derivative and physical trade is confirmed with the counterparty by a function independent of the dealer.
controls.risk: Fictitious or mis-booked trades remaining undetected.
testOfDesign: Confirm back office receives confirmations directly from counterparties or brokers.
testOfEffectiveness: Select a sample of trades and agree trade terms to independent counterparty confirmations; inspect follow-up of unmatched items.
checklist: Is each sampled trade supported by a matched confirmation?
Are unconfirmed trades chased and escalated?
controls.recommendation: Match all confirmations independently and escalate unconfirmed trades past the agreed ageing.

controls.title: Hedge designation documented at inception
controls.objective: Hedge relationships are formally designated and documented at inception so that hedge accounting is supportable.
controls.risk: Hedge accounting disallowed, causing earnings volatility and misstatement.
testOfDesign: Inspect the hedge documentation template for objective, hedged item, instrument, hedge ratio and effectiveness method.
testOfEffectiveness: For a sample of new hedge relationships confirm documentation was completed on or before the designation date.
checklist: Was documentation in place at inception for each hedge?
controls.recommendation: Complete hedge documentation on or before designation and review it monthly with accounting.

controls.title: Independent price verification of mark-to-market
controls.objective: Derivative and inventory valuations use independently sourced market prices.
controls.risk: Misstated profits or exposures from inaccurate valuations.
testOfDesign: Confirm month-end prices are sourced by a function independent of trading.
testOfEffectiveness: For sampled month-ends re-perform price verification against exchange or vendor data and inspect resolution of differences above threshold.
controls.recommendation: Perform independent month-end price verification with documented investigation of differences.

controls.title: Audit and control deficiencies tracked to closure
controls.objective: Agreed management actions are tracked, validated and closed on time.
testOfDesign: Inspect the action-tracking process and reporting to the audit committee.
testOfEffectiveness: Select closed actions and verify evidence of remediation; select open actions and assess overdue status and escalation.
controls.recommendation: Validate closure evidence before closing actions and report overdue actions to the audit committee.
